_: B_TN (Darknut) shield-bash parry / guard-open port, ACTOR half.
Subclass technique (cf. flurry.json): the ported bodies live on AlbwBtn_c, a
layout-compatible daB_TN_c subclass, so unqualified member access compiles and
sibling calls resolve to the EXPORTED stock methods through inheritance. The only
transform on a body is the daB_TN_c:: -> AlbwBtn_c:: rename on definition headers,
plus the one declared m_attack_tn substitution below.
skip_deps = every daB_TN_c method the subclass INHERITS from the exported stock
base (reproducing them would emit a second, shadowing copy of half the actor),
plus albwDebugLogEvent, which is an ADAPTER in btn_parry.cpp (the fork body does a
raw fopen into %USERPROFILE% - a per-frame hazard and a user-path leak).
daB_TN_HIO_c / l_HIO are deliberately NOT skipped: executeChaseH reads
l_HIO.mTimer3NormalType0/1, a non-exported file static, so the donor's own HIO
class + ctor defaults are reproduced verbatim (the flurry GAP-2 precedent). The
class DECLARATION is provided by hand in btn_parry.cpp - port_tool's documented
KNOWN LIMITATION keys a class and its out-of-line ctor on the same name.
